Voice — calls, conferences, multiparty, recordings, endpoints

Usage:
  plivo voice [flags]
  plivo voice [command]

Available Commands:
  calls       Make and inspect voice calls
  conferences Inspect and control live audio conferences
  endpoints   Manage SIP endpoints (registered SIP devices/usernames)
  multiparty  Multi-Party Calls (MPC) — group voice rooms with dynamic participants
  recordings  List, fetch, and delete call/conference recordings
  streams     Voice media streaming — local-dev WebSocket workflows

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for voice

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo voice [command] --help" for more information about a command.
